name: Fate Weaver
texts: When you play me, look at the top 4 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a spell with Energy cost :rb_energy_4: or more from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest.
manual: When you play me, look at the top 4 cards of your Main Deck.
You may reveal a spell with Energy cost :rb_energy_4: or more from among them and draw it.
